game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in The Kingdom – Throne Hall, the throne hall of the kingdom: the knight must handle mischievous imps while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Inventory Slots: Store each item in its own variable and choose which one to spend against mischievous imps.
theme: The Kingdom – Throne Hall: the throne hall of the kingdom
core_gameplay_loop: In Throne Hall, repeat each round: Store each item in its own variable and choose which one to spend against mischievous imps. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the potion value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 13 consecutive correct decisions about potion to power up the knight and open the signal beacon.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 9 (extended tier): Inventory Slots
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Inventory Slots' (Week 1 slot 8), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Throne Hall'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how potion changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mischievous imps in Throne Hall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 13.
